tool_arguments.query: AMD EPYC CPU revenue Q2 fiscal 2026 data center segment contribution

events.content: AMD EPYC CPU revenue Q2 fiscal 2026 data center segment contribution

AMD’s Q2 FY2026 Data Center revenue was **$6.718 billion** (reported as $6.7 billion), up **107% year over year** and **16% sequentially**; it represented approximately **58% of AMD’s $11.536 billion** consolidated revenue. [[1]] [[2]] 

AMD did **not disclose separate dollar revenue contributions** for Instinct GPUs versus EPYC CPUs within the segment. [[2]] 

The disclosed drivers were: **EPYC sales rose more than 70% year over year**, supported by record enterprise sell-through, cloud demand, and higher unit shipments and ASPs; **Instinct sales more than doubled year over year**, led by the continued MI350-series ramp and broader adoption among major AI labs and cloud providers. [[2]] 

Thus, both products were material contributors to the $6.7 billion result, but AMD’s public Q2 disclosure does not support a precise Instinct-versus-EPYC revenue split. [[1]] [[2]]

Sources:
[S4.1] AMD Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results :: Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (AMD) — https://ir.amd.com/news-events/press-releases/detail/1295/amd-reports-second-quarter-2026-financial-results
[S4.2] AMD 2Q26 Earnings Call Transcript JOHN: — https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_064d5906a8eb4ebea4947921aef4b9b7/amd/db/841/9237/webcast_transcript/AMD2Q26EarningsCallTranscript.pdf
